Sheets: [Join pod] opens a join-preview Sheet; [Create circle] opens setup; [Manage] partners opens permissions; [Report] opens the Report/Block flow — moderation never uses a swipe-only destructive path.
imageSlots: HIFI-95-01 - avatar or message attachment slot; screen-specific; premium warm-dark product placeholder. Prompt: Pods hub avatar or social proof placeholders, Balencia warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text.
trustControls: Membership count honesty triple: real reads server membership + ChipProvenance; low-confidence shows muted cached membership + 'estimated · low confidence'; honest-null reads 'No groups joined yet.'
Invite state honesty triple: real shows pending/accepted/expired timestamp; low-confidence shows muted 'invite service delayed'; honest-null hides the invite badge entirely.

Shared goal match honesty triple: real shows ChipProvenance 'consented goal overlap' (no invented percentage); low-confidence shows muted 'topic-only estimate'; honest-null hides the match until consent is given.
Partner visibility honesty triple: real shows per-domain toggles; low-confidence shows muted 'sync pending'; honest-null shows 'discovery off'.
CIA suggestion honesty triple: real shows 'goal + consent evidence'; low-confidence shows muted '1 signal'; honest-null hides the CIAInsightCard entirely — never a fabricated match.
Pods hub exposes audience/visibility preview, report, mute, block, and own-content delete controls before any sharing or social comparison; buddy discovery can be revoked or deleted at any time.
Source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete wherever group/social data appears.
Route locked to /groups; no alternate vanity routes.
notes:
States — Skeleton: PodCards render avatar/title/action geometry shimmer only, no fake member counts. Empty: HonestNullState offers Create circle, Broaden filters, and discovery controls (see belowFold). Error: cached groups stay visible with stale ChipProvenance and a retry action — 'Groups could not refresh. Showing last synced memberships.' Success: join/create/leave updates the row in place with glow-done and a clear undo where safe. Disabled: join, invite, message, and discovery controls dim to 40% opacity with a screen-reader reason string when consent, age gate, moderation, connectivity, or entitlement blocks the action.
Motion — Load: hero first, tabs second, PodCards in a 40ms stagger. Join: opens a preview Sheet; success collapses to joined state and updates AvatarStack. Search/filter: results crossfade; the empty state does not move footer controls. Moderation: report/block uses an action Sheet, no swipe-only destructive path. Reduced-motion: disables stagger, avatar transitions, and glow breathing.
Accessibility — Contrast: all text/chips clear AA+ on warm-dark surfaces. Targets: tabs, PodCards, join/manage/report, avatars, and toggles are 44px minimum. Screen readers: PodCards announce name, privacy, member count, shared goal, and join state.
Corrections made from the draft packet: (1) PodCard and Circle rows were mis-specified as glass — the spec's Visual treatment explicitly assigns hero and CIA card to GlassCard and PodCards/moderation rows to SolidCard #211008; fixed to solid. (2) the 'goal overlap · 92%' provenance chip was a fabricated confidence number not present anywhere in the spec — replaced with the Data Honesty section's actual real-state wording, 'consented goal overlap'. (3) the 'Circle' tag was colored purple, but purple/glow-cia is reserved for CIA synthesis only per canon — recolored to a neutral muted chip. (4) the CIA tag was marked italic, which would create a second italic-emphasis word; the spec allows exactly one ('*pods*'), so the CIA module is now explicit that it carries no italic. (5) italicWord placement: the draft attached the italic mark to 'Your groups', a string that never contains the word 'pods' — moved the italic mark onto the literal 'pods' text that already exists in the hero caption ('2 pods'), and normalized the italicWord field from '*pods*' to the bare word 'pods' per packet convention. (6) module count trimmed from 9 to 8 by merging the trust-footer caption into the floating-nav module. (7) belowFold and imageSlots were reshaped from objects to the required string-array schema, and trustControls was expanded from bare keyword fragments ('report', 'mute', 'block') into full honesty-triple / consent statements covering every Data Honesty and Consent-and-Safety line in the spec.
